name: Carbon Credit Eligibility Demo
description: Reference implementation showing how a downstream Guardian project consumes GDSTComplianceCredential VCs issued by the Starfish DPP-Hedera Standard Registry. The policy filters incoming VCs by issuer DID and credentialSubject.complianceStatus, surfaces the full trust chain via trustChainBlock, then issues a downstream CarbonCreditEligibility VC. NOT RUNNABLE AS-IS — a downstream operator must: (1) replace trustedIssuer with the testnet/mainnet SR DID for their target environment (see docs/guardian-integration/README.md §Testnet Integration Facts); (2) import or republish the GDSTComplianceCredential VC schema in their own SR namespace; (3) provide a CarbonCreditEligibility schema (the carbon-credit issuance contract is the downstream operator's deliverable, not Starfish's); (4) regenerate the placeholder block ids before POST /policies. Demonstrates spec §FR-001 / §SC-004 composability and US4 acceptance scenario A4.2.

children.description: Receives a GDSTComplianceCredential VC via POST /external/{policyId}/cc_vc_intake. Wire your VC source — a presentation request, an audit pipeline, or a manual upload form — to this block. The schema reference assumes the downstream SR has imported (or re-published) the GDSTComplianceCredential VC schema; published schema IRIs from the Starfish SR are documented in schemas/gdst/.

Trust-anchor filter — admits only VCs whose `issuer` is the configured Starfish SR DID and whose `credentialSubject.complianceStatus` is `compliant`. The TRUSTED_ISSUER constant below is testnet; downstream operators MUST replace it with the appropriate SR DID for their target environment (a single deployment SHOULD never mix testnet and mainnet DIDs — Constitution §Technology Baseline). Throwing in the expression aborts policy execution for non-conformant VCs; the trust-chain block downstream is not reached.

Renders the full Hedera DID + VC chain backing the input GDSTComplianceCredential. Auditors see the issuing SR DID, the underlying eventHash, and any superseding history (FR-014). Pure verification/display — does not modify the document flow.

Issues a downstream CarbonCreditEligibility VC keyed on the input GDSTComplianceCredential's eventHash + species. Real implementations replace this with policy-specific carbon-credit logic — allocation, pool assignment, retirement, monetisation. The CarbonCreditEligibility schema is the downstream operator's deliverable; Starfish ships only the GDST half of the trust chain.
